notes.title: Hamlet; Saving, Settings, a real game!
notes.content:
Hamlet 0.212
Redid the entire game from scratch.
Saving, Settings, and lots of 'game' is done.

Logging - Logging for profit.
0.22 - 0.29 plans in game.

More to come soon!

notes.title: v0.10 Beta Branch Notes
notes.content:
Hamlet v0.10

Feature
Includes correct maps with chunks
Cameras are now based on Game Types.
Added in Initial NPC Dialog improvements.

YouTube: Development Log - Micaiah Stevens has a YouTube programming channel with development logs and more.  if you are interested in how the game is being made.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vzf1RV0K5Zk&list=PLRvxxqwX6xXIvTBquJgEVpfqg-UAbzbAN

Enjoy the game; continue to let us know if something is out of place.
See Discussion Board for full patch notes.

notes.title: 0.09 on Beta Branch
notes.content:
[h1]Hamlet v0.09 - 2019 on Steam[/h1]
(Beta Branch)

[h1]Announcement[/h1]
See v0.08 Beta Branch for Live Notes
Note: Slight correction was v0.8 meant v0.08

[h1]YouTube[/h1]
Soon Micaiah Stevens will update his YouTube Channel for new Devlogs, if you are interested in how the game is being made.  Links below.

[h1]Feature[/h1]
Added in Adventure (Roguelike – Single Character)
New Menu with Graphics

Enjoy the game; continue to let us know if something is out of place.

[h1]Next Update[/h1]
(Considered in development, not promised, just heads up)

More stable Modes for Campaign, Sandbox, and Adventure
Planned more debug information, so you can help us test better.
Dungeon; delve into a Dungeon and explore the underworld.
Note: Unsure when the Dungeon will be ready, probably a few more updates.
Interact with more things, Rocks, Bushes, and more.

[h1]support@havenstudios.net[/h1]
